collection.title: BMW 2 Series Active Tourer 2014 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 2 Series Active Tourer 2014 - 2022 requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and a 19" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this 2 Series Active Tourer which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
